input.title: Women's Strawberry – Please Don't Pick Me Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This strawberry zip up hoodie is for the shy woman who would rather be left on the vine with a book, zipped on for the farmers market and the quiet corner of every party.

A shy, blushing strawberry with leafy hair hugs a small book to its chest, standing in a few fallen leaves, in red, blush, sage and cream with a worn print texture. PLEASE DON'T runs above it and PICK ME below in heavy slab capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: coral and cream on Black and Navy, red and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small strawberry with a leafy cap and a shy side glance is embroidered on the left chest, and the word SHY is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest strawberry and left-cuff SHY, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Please Don't Pick Me zip hoodie fit?
The Please Don't Pick Me strawberry zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this strawberry hoodie warm enough for cool farmers market mornings?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool farmers market mornings, berry-picking fields and quiet park afternoons well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, PLEASE DON'T above the art and PICK ME below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small strawberry with a leafy cap and a shy side glance sits on the left chest with no words, and SHY is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The strawberry on the chest and the SHY cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a shy book lover, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who would rather stay home with a book than be picked for a team. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
